description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeavePeriodServiceTrait' which provides a method to access the 'LeavePeriodService' within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin system. It includes namespace declarations, uses another trait for service container management, and provides a utility method to retrieve the leave period service from the dependency injection container.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodService
methods.description: Retrieves the instance of LeavePeriodService from the dependency injection container.
